scope: Seven alternating fresh-process baseline/candidate pairs. PRIMARY comparison is actual production arm in copy-only baseline versus actual production arm in rectangle-range candidate, using identical frozen harness. The old frozen virtual arm includes earlier copies and is retained only as output oracle/control, never as incremental raster baseline. Each process has2 warmup pairs then16 FailClosed or4 rectangle pairs with output destruction included. Normal Geometry mainopt0 test profile, MLS/runtimeopt3. Setup/assertions excluded. Combined process CPU/RSS includes old reference, production and fixture copies, not per-version application resources. Pooled operation quantiles are finite observed samples, not realtime guarantees.

Old virtual reference includes copy work and is only output oracle/measurement control. Result drop included; no session/socket startup; not release.

disposition.scope: Exact rectangle behavior and local gain qualified. The one predefined isolated FailClosed experiment completed 28/28 runs and did not reproduce consistent slowdown. Original adverse matched controls remain evidence; isolated results do not erase them, prove general FailClosed non-regression, or establish causation. No all-path performance acceptance, release, realtime, hardware, guard or lock-contention claim.
disposition.decision: After independent review, retain only the 42-line Inside Rectangle range candidate with the documented bounded qualification and stop performance attribution experiments.

isolation_experiment.scope: One predefined isolation experiment: separate fresh-process exact selector per size, seven alternating baseline/candidate pairs,2 production warmups and16 production calls only before or during timing. Reference/input/header parity checks run afterward. Each returned MapState destruction is timed. Same mixed Geometry opt0 MLS/runtime opt3 test profile, not release. Whole-process CPU/RSS includes fixture and postchecks; not attributable to measured operations. This isolated harness changes binary layout versus the original full benchmark; neither observation is erased by the other. Stop attribution after this experiment.

orchestration.event: The initial baseline Cargo artifact was overwritten by the candidate before independent capture; discovered before any isolated measurement. No measurement used that overwritten baseline. Candidate was frozen first, exact unchanged baseline rebuilt once and frozen, then candidate source restored.

baseline_capture_recovery.reason: Original baseline executable was overwritten by candidate before capture; no isolated measurements used it. Rebuild exact baseline solely to freeze artifact.

isolation_experiment.interpretation: Distinct experiment, never replacing the original matched observations. Candidate wins5/7 at512 and4/7 at4096;4096 candidate pooled P95 is132.123263ms versus baseline129.936472ms. Candidate adverse pairs are512:[1,6] and4096:[3,4,6]. Independent review and bounded disposition after independent review: retain the narrow rectangle candidate and stop attribution; no additional performance runs or tuning.
